test_title: PYST 47: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A manufacturer fixes his selling price at 30% over the cost of production. If the cost of production goes up by 30%, and the manufacturer raises his selling price by 70%, find the profit percentage.
solution:
**Given:**

Initial cost of production = C

Selling price is fixed at 30% over the cost of production. So, initial selling price = C + 30% of C = 1.3C

Cost of production increases by 30%, so new cost of production = C + 30% of C = 1.3C

Selling price increases by 70%, so new selling price = 1.3C + 70% of 1.3C = 1.3 × 1.7C = 2.21C
